extra.notes: Pre-registered grid for the trading-comps strategy (research/04_trading_comps.md sections 5-7). 3 theta {0.10,0.15,0.20} x 3 P/E cap {30,40,50} x 3 EV/EBITDA cap {25,35,45} x size filter {on,off} = 54 cells, TTM basis only. The team doc also lists 'TTM vs forward': forward multiples CANNOT be backtested point-in-time with free data (there are no historical consensus estimates and realized future earnings would be look-ahead), so 'forward' is pre-registered as NOT BACKTESTABLE; yfinance forwardPE is shown for the live date as an information-only cross-check column (not tuned, not in the selection). The last-fiscal-year (LFY) basis is a pre-registered robustness check run ONLY at the cell chosen on the train window (basis='LFY'); it is not part of the selection grid and counts as an extra trial in the ledger. Train window: signals 2012-01-31..2018-12-31; test window 2019-01..latest, looked at once for the chosen cell (plateau rule research/06 5.4, research/04 7.3-7.4). Rules fixed across all cells: sub-industry peers with industry fallback if < 4, size window 0.5x-2x with the 5 closest peers (size filter on) or all valid peers (off), caps applied to peers AND targets, negative multiples ignored, stale (>135d) and recent IPO/merger names excluded, peers trimmed to 0.5x-2x of their median (>= 3 kept), BUY if multiple < (1-theta) x benchmark for BOTH multiples, key-metric gates (ND/EBITDA <= 3, FCF + margin stability, ROIC > WACC) on the target only, top 20 by average discount, equal weight 1/max(k,5), 10 bps one-way costs, universe = point-in-time S&P 900 (S&P 500 + MidCap 400) ex Financials/Real Estate, mcap >= $300M, price >= $5, peers drawn from the same universe. UNIVERSE CHANGED TO SP900 BEFORE ANY GRID RUN BECAUSE S&P 600 HISTORY STARTS 2018-09 (Wikipedia has no earlier S&P 600 membership; including it would add about 600 small caps exactly at the 2019 train/test boundary and confound the comparison). The first version of this registration (2026-10-19T02:09:35Z, same 54-cell grid) named the S&P 1500; only a train-window sanity run of the DEFAULT cell (stage counts, no return statistics) had been looked at before the change. Known biases and data constraints: survivorship of the index membership, GICS as per the membership snapshots (point-in-time names/codes, not restated), no analyst estimates; names without a GICS sub-industry code are dropped and counted; peer groups are thinner in a 900-name universe, so the industry fallback and the 'no signal' share are high and are reported per rebalance (diagnostics); the 135-day staleness gate removes names that have not yet filed their 10-K at February month-ends - all reported, none tuned.
extra.lfy_robustness: basis='LFY' at the chosen cell only; extra trial, never used for selection

windows.test_policy: single look at the chosen cell

extra.rebalance: month-end signal, trade at next close, hold one month
extra.v2_rationale: v2 (registered before any v2 run): v1 choice (caps 40/35, no size filter) kept; adds a value-trap momentum filter (0/30/50%); theta 10/15/20%. Default = v1 choice (theta 10%).
